# From Scarcity to Three Questions

<!-- STEP id="meet" -->
Wants are unlimited. Resources are limited. When the two meet, we get **scarcity**: there is not enough to satisfy every want.

<!-- STEP id="choices" -->
Scarcity forces us to choose. Rich countries and poor countries both face it, and so do rich and poor families.

<!-- STEP id="branch" -->
So every economy must answer three key questions: **what** to produce, **how** to produce it, and **for whom** to produce it.
